original_innovations.name: Dynamic Pattern with Blockified Structure
original_innovations.description: Introduces a blockified pattern to efficiently capture hierarchical sparsity in DiTs, addressing the limitation of continuous patterns in hierarchical structures
original_innovations.explanation: Unlike traditional continuous sparse patterns (col, diag) that fail with DiTs' hierarchical organization, the blockified pattern divides attention into frame regions and captures local continuous structures while maintaining global block-level sparsity
original_innovations.runtime_improvement: Reduces complexity from O(L²d) to O((1-sparsity)L²d)

original_innovations.name: Fused LSE-Cached Online Search
original_innovations.description: First method to enable precise online search without training or profiling by leveraging LSE invariance across denoising steps
original_innovations.explanation: Exploits the observation that sparse patterns and LSE distributions remain invariant across denoising steps, enabling caching of LSE values to reduce search time by 50%
original_innovations.runtime_improvement: Search time reduced to <5% of full attention generation time

original_innovations.name: Head-adaptive Hierarchical Block Sparse Attention
original_innovations.description: Adapts sparsity levels per attention head based on their individual characteristics while maintaining computational balance
original_innovations.explanation: Identifies heads with high/low recall and adjusts their sparsity levels hierarchically, improving accuracy without changing average sparsity
original_innovations.runtime_improvement: Maintains same computational load while improving quality

identified_gaps.description: Method is specifically designed for 3D Full Attention and may not generalize to other attention mechanisms like Spatial-Temporal Attention
Uses fixed block_size=64 which may not be optimal for all video resolutions or aspect ratios
Experiments conducted on single A100 GPU, missing distributed/multi-GPU scenarios
Only tested on HunyuanVideo and CogVideoX1.5-5B, missing broader model validation

proposed_improvements.name: Adaptive Block Size Selection
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic block size selection based on video resolution and content characteristics
proposed_improvements.implementation: Add heuristic to select optimal block_size ∈ {32, 64, 128} based on frame resolution (h×w) and content complexity metrics
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L, L, d) with adaptive block size B ∈ {32,64,128}
proposed_improvements.benefit: Improve recall by 5-10% for varying resolutions

proposed_improvements.name: Multi-Modal Attention Fusion
proposed_improvements.description: Extend method to handle additional modalities (audio, depth) beyond video-text
proposed_improvements.implementation: Modify hierarchical structure to include audio tokens and depth maps, extending block pattern to 4D (video-text-audio-depth)
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L', L', d) where L' = f·h·w + t + a + d (a=audio tokens, d=depth tokens)
proposed_improvements.benefit: Enable sparse attention for multimodal video generation

proposed_improvements.name: Progressive Sparsity Scheduling
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic sparsity adjustment during denoising process based on noise levels
proposed_improvements.implementation: Implement sparsity scheduler that increases sparsity as noise decreases: sparsity_t = sparsity_base + α(1 - σ_t/σ_0)
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L, L, d) with time-varying sparsity sparsity_t

proposed_improvements.name: Distributed Sparse Attention
proposed_improvements.description: Extend method for multi-GPU/distributed inference with efficient communication
proposed_improvements.implementation: Implement block-wise partitioning across GPUs with halo exchange for boundary blocks, maintaining sparsity patterns across devices
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L/n_gpu, L, d) for n_gpu devices with communication overhead
proposed_improvements.benefit: Enable generation of longer videos (>1 minute) with linear scaling

proposed_improvements.name: Learnable Pattern Refinement
proposed_improvements.description: Lightweight learned refinement of sparse patterns using meta-networks
proposed_improvements.implementation: Add small MLP (2 layers, 128 hidden units) to refine block selection based on content features, trained with distillation loss
proposed_improvements.expected_runtime: Get_Time(L, L, d) + O(L·d) for MLP inference
proposed_improvements.benefit: Improve recall by 3-5% with minimal overhead
